summary: Thin spatial-query delegate: reads a vehicle-like object's position and two search parameters, then forwards them to SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch on the scene's spatial tree with filter value 0, returning the resulting nearest-neighbor handle (or zero when none found).

operations.description: Resolve the position vector pointer at this + 13536 to use as the query position.

Call SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch with the spatial tree from dword_5EA2C0, the position pointer at this + 13536, the search parameter at this + 17236 (0x4354), the search parameter at this + 17744 (0x4550), and filter value 0.
Return the nearest-neighbor search result: a handle to the nearest entity, or zero when none is found.
Invoked by sub_4A4110 and FindNearestVehicle to perform nearest-neighbor queries on behalf of AI callers.
